description: This file provides tenant encryption helper functions for backend parity, including deriving encryption keys from tenant salt configuration, and functions to encrypt and decrypt tenant IDs using AES-128-ECB with base64 encoding.

methods.name: deriveKeyFromSalt
methods.description: Derives a 16-byte encryption key from the tenant salt configuration by decoding base64url salt and hashing it with SHA-256.

methods.name: encryptTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts a tenant ID string using AES-128-ECB and returns a base64-encoded string without padding.

methods.name: decryptTenantId
methods.description: Decrypts a base64-encoded encrypted tenant ID back to plaintext using AES-128-ECB.
